description: Approves one pending approval, named by id, with an optional note, and the held action goes ahead: a refund the AI receptionist asked for (payment.refund, order.refund) is paid out once and the customer is told. An approval past its 24 hours is rejected instead, not approved, and one already decided is refused. Each approval needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that shows the approval and returns a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it approves.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

name: approve_request
title: Approve a held action
